'''2005 Norwegian National Championship Thomas Caspersen LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Caspersen]] at [[2005 Norwegian National Championship]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Thomas "Gaurhir" Caspersen (2005-05-01).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34730 Norwegian Nationals 1st Place (Light Side)]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050518071822/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34730&PHPSESSID=...328fedb22570524062aeb1303 Internet Archive]</ref>
